fields.name: id
fields.doc: ID of the new entity: a symbol ($crate) that later calls in the batch can use, or a concrete unused record ID. Minted when absent.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: Parent entity; absent creates a root. May be inside a prefab instance.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: Position among the parent's children; absent appends.

fields.name: components
fields.doc: Components to add, by type name; {} uses every default.
